title: Public package exports omit outgoing message schemas defined in the module
reasoning: outgoing.py defines QueryAcceptedMessage/Payload and WebSearchProgressMessage/Payload, but the package-level schema import surface and __all__ omit them while exporting most other outgoing message schemas. Consumers importing from backend.src.api.schemas cannot access these message contracts through the package surface even though they are first-class outgoing schemas.
recommendation: Import and include the missing outgoing schema classes in backend/src/api/schemas/__init__.py, or document that these specific classes are intentionally module-private and keep them out of the package contract consistently.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included, and there is no export-surface test asserting every outgoing message schema is re-exported from the package.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a package export test that imports QueryAcceptedMessage and WebSearchProgressMessage from backend.src.api.schemas, or a parameterized test covering all intended public outgoing schema classes.
minimumFixScope: Update __init__.py exports for the missing outgoing schemas and add an import/export regression test.
